name: Playasia Deal Watcher
description: Weekly Playasia clearance check that renders a branded deal-card image and posts it with a caption to the PlayAsia Deals Telegram channel

with.message:
Weekly Playasia deal check for Joe (site: https://putraindex.github.io/playasia-deals/, channel: https://t.me/PlayAsiaDeals).

1. Browse https://www.play-asia.com/en/clearance/00/71365 with browser tools (curl is 403-blocked). Open a category (e.g. 'Clearance Sale 2026 Playstation 4/5' or 'Nintendo switch'), wait ~5s for the JS product list, read names + prices + 'You save: N%'.
2. Pick 4-6 standout deals: 50%+ off on recognizable titles or big discounts on rare/collectible items. Skip anything under ~40% unless notable.
3. Render a deal card image with Python + PIL (zero credits, fonts at /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/): 1080x1080 PNG, dark background #0F1420, card rows #171E2E, accent #FF5722, header 'PLAYASIA / CLEARANCE 2026', one row per deal with name, price and % OFF, footer with the site URL and t.me/PlayAsiaDeals. Save to deal-card.png.
4. Post it with Python multipart upload (NOT curl -F: curl file uploads fail in the sandbox with error 26). Build a multipart body with fields chat_id='@PlayAsiaDeals', caption (the deal list as plain text ending with 'Full deals: https://putraindex.github.io/playasia-deals/'), and the photo file, then POST to https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendPhoto. Use NO parse_mode anywhere.
5. If the photo post fails, fall back to a plain-text sendMessage to @PlayAsiaDeals; if that also fails, DM Joe the ready-to-forward text.
6. On success, DM Joe one short confirmation line. If no standout deals, post nothing and message no one.

Be frugal: browser + bash/python only, no web searches, no other tools.
